response.description:
Packet capture Insights uses
AI-assisted analysis to surface key findings from packet captures and can
ingest structured protocol logs into log analytics ingestion for deeper investigation. Packet capture insights help make
capture data more accessible by surfacing meaningful network observations
without requiring you to manually inspect every packet. You can use these
insights to reduce investigation time, identify abnormal behavior, and troubleshoot
connectivity, performance issues more efficiently especially when captures are
large or complex. Optionally ingesting the derived protocol logs
into a Log Analytics workspace preserves structured evidence for deeper
investigation, correlation, validation, and repeatable KQL analysis after the
insight summary is generated.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Packet capture insights
